other_conditions: Candidates must be pursuing undergraduate, postgraduate or research studies in any discipline from recognized, reputed institutions with a stellar academic record.
Applicants should possess skills in Information Technology (IT) and Information Communication Technology (ICT) along with good communication and interpersonal skills.
Interns must be subject to the laws of secrecy of the country and must sign a Secrecy and Non‑Disclosure Agreement before reporting for the internship.
benefits_summary: Interns receive a token remuneration of ₹12,000 per month (all‑inclusive), logistics support (office space and computer with internet), and an experience certificate/recommendatory letter upon successful completion.
